(₹78,000 subsidy plus up to ₹20,000 special discount - Dussehra & Deepavali Dhamaka Offer.)

ad_library.summary: Orizen Solar Innovations is running a live Telugu ad on Meta (Library ID 3529873930505195, started 18 September 2026, multiple versions) offering a Dussehra & Deepavali Dhamaka package - ₹78,000 subsidy, 3KW with ₹10,000 off, 5KW with ₹20,000 off, free panel-cleaning brush, WAAREE authorised channel partner - and every click goes to WhatsApp. The company is headquartered in Guntur with three AP offices (Guntur, Vijayawada, Tirupati) and is advertising into Telangana.

funnel.meaning: The paid click goes straight to a chat. Nothing is measured, nothing is retargeted, and the site's on-grid/off-grid/hybrid pages - all of them - never get seen by the buyer the ad paid for.

findings: Live Telugu ad (Library ID 3529873930505195, running since 18 September 2026, multiple versions) - the Dussehra & Deepavali offer sends every click to WhatsApp; orizensolar.com receives none of the traffic.
Three phone numbers across the funnel: the ad (8374 670 999 / 8374 683 999) and the site (+91 9962039859) - split numbers for one offer.
The live site still carries template text: the PM Surya Ghar blurb reads 'At Your Solar Partner, we are proud to support this initiative' - the company name was never filled in.

The features section is headed 'Features of Origin Solar Panels' - 'Origin', not 'Orizen' - and every 'Read More' service link points at '#' (the homepage anchor), so nothing on the site answers what the ad promises.
Guntur-based with offices in Vijayawada and Tirupati, advertising into Telangana - no Telangana service-area proof for the buyer the ad is aimed at.
next_steps: Put the Dussehra & Deepavali offer - ₹78,000 subsidy, 3KW/5KW discounts, WAAREE partnership - on a page you control, with name and phone captured before the WhatsApp hand-off.
'Your Solar Partner' in the PM Surya Ghar blurb and 'Origin Solar' in the features heading are the first trust breaks a visitor finds.
Every 'Read More' points at the homepage anchor - the on-grid, off-grid and hybrid pages exist in the nav but are unreachable from the homepage flow.
Unify the numbers and add local proof
One phone number everywhere, plus a Telangana service-area statement, turns a Guntur advertiser into a local option for the Telugu buyer.

controls.name: Meta Pixel installed
controls.evidence: Landing page was not source-checked for this report; needs a page-source pull or account access.

controls.name: UTM parameters on ad destinations
controls.evidence: Destination URL captured but parameter list not verified; needs the full click-through URL from Ads Manager.

controls.name: Domain verification
controls.evidence: Business Manager domain verification cannot be observed from public ad data; needs account access.

controls.name: Creative format diversity
controls.evidence: Ad-card formats were not captured for these ads.

controls.name: Creative concept coverage
controls.evidence: 3 distinct offer angles in live copy: government subsidy, subsidy amount, discount offer.

controls.name: Social proof utilization
controls.evidence: No social proof (customer counts, reviews, testimonials) in the live ad copy.

controls.name: Video aspect ratios
controls.evidence: Creative files cannot be downloaded from the Ad Library; needs account access or the raw creatives.

controls.name: UGC / social-native content
controls.evidence: Content style cannot be verified from ad cards alone.

controls.name: CTR benchmark
controls.evidence: No spend or impression data is public for this advertiser; the catalog forbids benchmark guessing.

controls.name: Creative freshness
controls.evidence: Live creatives include recent launches (newest started Sep 18, 2026) - the account is not running one stale ad forever.

controls.name: Campaign fragmentation
controls.evidence: A single live ad - no internal comparison, no safety net if it fatigues.

controls.name: Campaign objective alignment
controls.evidence: Ad CTA and destination agree on one job: WhatsApp only.

controls.name: Creative fatigue detection
controls.evidence: Frequency and performance decay need account metrics.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data
